About GreenMap AI
GreenMap AI
How it began
GreenMap AI started as a final-year college project with a simple goal: make it easier for people in Andhra Pradesh to discover renewable energy — where the sun and wind resources are strongest, which local shops sell solar and wind equipment, and how to compare products before buying.
Purpose
The app brings together three tools in one place — Smart Energy Search for comparing products, EnergyScope AP for exploring solar and wind potential across the state, and EnergyHub for finding and buying from real local renewable energy shops nearby.
